items.html: And the Nukva of ZA is in the place of Aba, by the secret of "He founded the earth in Hochma," for Aba founded the daughter (Barat). And by the secret of "and you shall keep the Sabbath, for it is holy" — for "keep" (shamor), which is the Nukva, is made "holy" (kodesh), which is Aba. And this is the meaning of "it is holy" — that she, the female, returned to be holy. And Beria rose into Ima, by the secret of what you know, that Ima nests in the throne (Kursiya). And Yetzira is in the place of ZA, for ZA nests in the angel. And Assiya in the Nukva of ZA, for Malchut nests in what is Assiya.
